This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior .NET Engineer based in Romania.
 As a Senior .NET Engineer, you will contribute to the development of backend solutions powering a major European digital automotive marketplace, reaching millions of users across multiple countries. You will join an established engineering team and take ownership of designing, building, and maintaining integration services and microservices. Your primary focus will be developing scalable, secure, and reliable solutions that connect enterprise platforms, customer relationship management systems, and data infrastructure. Working with modern cloud technologies and event-driven architectures, you will help ensure seamless data flows and operational efficiency. You will collaborate closely with technical leads and fellow engineers, contributing to architectural decisions and delivering features from development through production. This role offers the opportunity to work on high-impact integration projects in a collaborative, international technology environment.
Accountabilities
Design, develop, and maintain .NET-based integration services and microservices supporting enterprise data integration initiatives, including Workday-to-Data-Lake and Marketplace-to-HubSpot solutions. 
Build, deploy, monitor, and provide operational support for cloud-based applications and services hosted on AWS, ensuring secure and reliable configurations. 
Develop robust API integrations, covering authentication, data contracts, pagination, batching, rate limiting, retries, error handling, and idempotent processing. 
Implement event-driven and asynchronous integration workflows, including webhooks, scheduled processes, historical data loads, and incremental data feeds. 
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reconciliation across integration pipelines, maintaining clear source-of-truth ownership and secure handling of financial and operational information. 
Collaborate with the squad's Tech Lead and other engineers to align technical solutions with the existing architecture, project priorities, and delivery roadmap. 
Contribute to technical design discussions and make informed engineering decisions that balance maintainability, scalability, and delivery speed. 
Produce clear technical documentation and actively participate in knowledge-sharing activities across the engineering team. 
Maintain sufficient technical overlap with the second integration engineer across both solutions to ensure continuity, collaboration, and consistent delivery. 
Support continuous improvement initiatives related to development practices, system reliability, and integration architecture. 
 Requirements
Strong professional experience with C# and the .NET ecosystem, particularly ASP.NET Core. 
Proven experience designing, developing, and maintaining microservices and distributed systems in production environments. 
Solid understanding of event-driven architectures, asynchronous messaging, and event-based integration patterns. 
Hands-on experience designing, developing, and integrating REST APIs. 
Good knowledge of relational databases and ORM frameworks, particularly Entity Framework Core. 
Ability to work comfortably with AI coding agents as part of everyday software development activities. 
Experience contributing to existing codebases, understanding established architectures, and delivering production-ready features efficiently. 
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of technical tasks. 
Ability to contribute constructively to technical decisions while balancing code quality, long-term maintainability, and delivery deadlines. 
Excellent collaboration, documentation, and knowledge-sharing skills within an established engineering team. 
Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with a minimum proficiency level of B2. 
Nice to have: Frontend development experience, particularly with Vue.js and TypeScript, and the ability to deliver full-stack features independently. 
Familiarity with AWS services such as ECS, SNS, SQS, and RDS, or equivalent cloud infrastructure services. 
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, monitoring and observability practices, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD). 
A proactive mindset and willingness to contribute to continuous technical improvement and collaborative engineering practices. 
 Benefits
Flexible working arrangements, with the option to work remotely, from an office, or through a hybrid setup. 
Competitive salary and comprehensive compensation package. 
Personalized career development opportunities tailored to individual professional goals. 
Access to mentorship programs, technical talks, training sessions, and specialized centers of excellence. 
Active technology communities encouraging collaboration and regular knowledge sharing. 
Education reimbursement to support continuous learning and professional development. 
Anniversary gifts and recognition of professional milestones. 
Corporate events, team-building activities, and opportunities to connect with colleagues. 
Additional location-specific benefits depending on the employment location. 
Note: Certain benefits may not apply to freelance or independent contractor arrangements.
